$comment: Models the AI gateway (services/worker-py/worker/ai.py) may call, per contour (AI_CONTOUR) and purpose. Anything not listed is refused. Prices are per 1,000 tokens, used to compute ai_calls.cost and the per-org LLM spend limit (docs/billing.md). A model with pricePer1kTokens null is refused unless it also has "unmetered": true, which exempts it from cost tracking and spend limits (pnpm check:ai-prices warns about both). Anthropic prices: list prices for the first-party API as of 2026-10-06 (Haiku 5.5: prompts up to 100K tokens) - verify against the provider's price page before relying on them. The ru entry is a placeholder for a self-hosted or in-country OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OPENAI_BASE_URL): replace the model id with the one your endpoint serves.
